decision_cruda.rationale: Central is truck-limited: trucks haul 91 t/h against 116 t/h loader inflow from the three remaining loaders, and the stockpile is 334/450 t. Over 7 h trucks can haul only about 640 t. Central already has roughly 1,060 t available between stockpile and stopes, so another loader on C512-02 adds no tonnes to surface. LH-04 should be back by 11:00-12:00 anyway. Norte and Este have no uncovered stopes with ore. Moving a development loader would give up value (LH-09 costs 5.7 oz/h) for nothing. LH-10 is free but has nowhere useful to go. No loans, and no reserves, since none of the stopes has stopped.
